entries.scope: Pinned macOS runner labels, current guidance and required-check migration
entries.rationale: GitHub retires macOS 14 on 2026-11-02; current runner guidance must match executable workflows.
readerPaths: Agent guidance -> runner migration guide -> workflow -> PR checks
entries.navigationImpact: Adds a linked bilingual runner guide to existing agent surfaces.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Local syntax and isolated migration-template checks; exact-head hosted CI results are recorded in PR checks before merge.
entries.risk: Runner images can change installed tool versions; CI is not native product acceptance.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Runner retirement, toolchain or required-check changes
